# CV-tuned long-horizon models: single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_long_cv_tuning.py`)

Git commit `7c32feb089`. Configuration chosen by expanding-window cross-validation inside the training period (three half-year folds of 2022-H2, 2023-H1, 2023-H2); the validation half-year (2024-H1) is NOT used for stopping or selection here. MAE in MW, mean prediction of 3 seeds.

## Horizon 72 h

CV choice: ridge ridge_full_rel alpha 100; XGBoost 144 trees (per fold [144, 41, 146], CV MAE 5,590); LSTM hidden 32, epochs 4 (per fold [2, 4, 4], CV MAE 5,874). Original (validation-tuned) choice: XGBoost trees [272, 419, 439], LSTM epochs [2, 1, 1].

| model | test MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| ridge | 6,244 |
| XGBoost S4 | 6,192 |
| LSTM L4 | 6,301 |

Against the original validation-tuned models of the same horizon (test MAE, difference CV-tuned minus original, 95% block bootstrap):

| model | original | CV-tuned | difference (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| ridge | 6,244 | 6,244 | +0 (+0 to +0) |
| XGBoost S4 | 6,018 | 6,192 | +173 (-45 to +391) |
| LSTM L4 | 6,200 | 6,301 | +101 (-162 to +428) |

CV-tuned models against each other (MAE difference, first minus second):

| first | second | difference (95% CI) |
|---|---|---|
| XGBoost S4 | ridge | -52 (-410 to +272) |
| LSTM L4 | XGBoost S4 | +110 (-380 to +628) |
| LSTM L4 | ridge | +58 (-386 to +510) |

## Horizon 168 h

CV choice: ridge ridge_g01_rel alpha 100; XGBoost 41 trees (per fold [41, 39, 305], CV MAE 7,125); LSTM hidden 16, epochs 1 (per fold [1, 2, 1], CV MAE 7,615). Original (validation-tuned) choice: XGBoost trees [2, 2, 2], LSTM epochs [1, 1, 1].

| model | test MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| ridge | 7,728 |
| XGBoost S4 | 8,048 |
| LSTM L4 | 7,938 |

Against the original validation-tuned models of the same horizon (test MAE, difference CV-tuned minus original, 95% block bootstrap):

| model | original | CV-tuned | difference (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| ridge | 7,743 | 7,728 | -14 (-310 to +238) |
| XGBoost S4 | 8,173 | 8,048 | -126 (-546 to +351) |
| LSTM L4 | 8,171 | 7,938 | -233 (-504 to +161) |

CV-tuned models against each other (MAE difference, first minus second):

| first | second | difference (95% CI) |
|---|---|---|
| XGBoost S4 | ridge | +319 (-107 to +989) |
| LSTM L4 | XGBoost S4 | -110 (-595 to +388) |
| LSTM L4 | ridge | +209 (-217 to +887) |
